title: 第24章 管你是谁第25章 王家婚礼
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“混账！”
看到手下被炸死，岳云顿时大怒，他的人直接冲到了欧阳锋的面前狠狠的一拳砸在了欧阳锋的躯体上。
砰！
咔嚓！
欧阳锋被砸的飞了出去，其人将后面的一棵巨大的树木给撞的断裂了起来，树叶果肉飞得到处都是。他倒在地上大口吐血起来，他的伤势更加的重了。
岳云纵身而来，他直接一只脚踏在了欧阳锋的胸膛上，用脚踩着他询问：“我再问你一次，藏宝图在哪里？乖乖的拿出来你就可以少受一点罪，不然的话老子凌迟了你。”
岳云手一动直接从身上摸出来了一把锋利的小刀子，他的嘴边浮现了一丝残忍的笑容。
岳云身为武道联盟的副盟主，他经常用这些残忍的手段对付一些罪犯，他最拿手这些了。
“你杀了我吧。”
欧阳锋吐了一口血，苍老的脸上浮现了一丝绝望，他没想到他竟然今天要死在这里，不过就算是死他也不会将藏宝图给予对方的，因为藏宝图这是他最值钱的东西，就算给他也是给最亲的人，而不是岳云这些败类。
“那好，我割你一块肉。”
岳云冷冷的道，他正打算用刀子割欧阳锋，不过就在此刻他忽然感觉到了劲风扑面，一个白色人影闪到了他的面前来。
这个白色人影速度奇快，快到了他压根来不及发现，也来不及躲闪，更加来不及抵挡。
砰！
岳云感觉胸口一疼，然后他感觉自己身体不受控制他的身子顿时飞了出去20米远，撞在了旁边的一块大石头上将石头都撞击的裂开了。岳云本人更是倒在了地上身上骨头都不知道断了多少根，他大口吐血起来，另外他的牙齿也掉了不少颗。
这突如其来的情况让武道联盟的人惊呆了，他们看到了现场出现了一个人，这个人正站在欧阳锋的身边，他那是一个一身白衣容貌俊美的青年，就是这个号青年一巴掌拍飞了岳云。
“老大是你。”
看到这个青年后，欧阳锋猛地从地上坐了起来满脸幸福，因为这个青年是陈锋。
“正所谓打狗还要看主人，这个人是我的小弟知道吗？就算是杀他打他也是我来动手，轮不到你们。”
背负双手的陈锋，他看着面前的武道联盟的人冷冷的道。

自然欧阳锋跟了他认他做大哥，他看到小弟被欺负自然不能不管的。
“你到底是谁？竟敢管我们武道联盟的事情，你确定你们要和武道联盟作对吗？”
岳云此刻也从地上爬了起来，他用手擦拭了下嘴巴的鲜血。岳云很是吃惊，要知道他可是内劲小成的武者啊，他的肉身强悍无比，一般的武者很少能有击败他的。但是如今的他竟然被自眼前这个年轻人拍飞出去还断了一根肋骨，他心里自然惊讶的不行，他想要搞清楚对方到底是谁。
“这位是我的老大，楚州陈大师，陈北玄，他是一个武者高手，你们还不跪下。”
有了老大撑腰，欧阳锋则开心了许多，他大声说道。
“楚州陈大师？”
“陈北玄？”
……
听到欧阳锋的话，岳云几个人则面面相觑，觉得有点耳熟，不过就是想不起来到底在哪里听过。
“小子，我不管你是谁，不过你要知道我们是武道联盟的人，代表的官方，你确定你要和官方作对，和我们武道联盟作对？”
岳云冷冷的道，他感觉面前的陈锋应该比他强，不然不会一巴掌打伤他，所以岳云希望用强大的背景来压服陈锋，毕竟岳云的武道联盟代表的江北官方势力。
“官你妹。”
content_en:
"Asshole!"
Seeing that his men were killed, Yue Yun was furious. His men rushed directly in front of Ouyang Feng and punched Ouyang Feng's body hard.
Bang!
Click!
Ouyang Feng was hit and flew out. He hit a huge tree behind him and broke it. The leaves and pulp flew everywhere. He fell to the ground and vomited blood, and his injuries became more serious.
Yue Yun jumped over. He directly put one foot on Ouyang Feng's chest, and asked him: "I ask you again, where is the treasure map? If you take it out obediently, you will suffer less. Otherwise, I will delay you."
Yue Yun moved his hand and took out a sharp knife directly from his body, and a cruel smile appeared on his lips.
As the deputy leader of the Martial Arts Alliance, Yue Yun often uses these cruel methods to deal with criminals, and he is best at these.
"You kill me."
Ouyang Feng spit out a mouthful of blood, and a trace of despair appeared on his old face. He did not expect that he would die here today, but even if he died, he would not give the treasure map to the other party, because the treasure map is his most valuable thing, and even if it is given to him, it will be given to the person closest to him, not scum like Yue Yun.
"Okay, I'll cut you a piece of flesh."
Yue Yun said coldly, he was about to cut Ouyang Feng with a knife, but at this moment he suddenly felt a strong wind blowing against his face, and a white figure flashed in front of him.
This white figure was so fast that he had no time to notice it, no time to dodge, and no time to resist.
Bang!
Yue Yun felt a pain in his chest, and then he felt that his body was out of control. His body suddenly flew 20 meters away, and hit a big rock next to it, causing the stone to crack. Yue Yun himself fell to the ground and had countless broken bones. He vomited blood, and many of his teeth were also lost.
This sudden situation shocked the people of the Martial Arts Alliance. They saw a person appear on the scene. This person was standing next to Ouyang Feng. He was a handsome young man dressed in white. It was this young man who slapped Yue Yun away.
"You are the boss."
After seeing this young man, Ouyang Feng suddenly sat up from the ground and his face was filled with happiness, because this young man was Chen Feng.
"As the saying goes, it depends on the owner to beat a dog. This man is my little brother, you know? Even if I kill him and beat him, it's me who does it, and it's not your turn."
Chen Feng, who had his hands behind his back, looked at the people from the martial arts alliance in front of him and said coldly.
Naturally, Ouyang Feng followed him and recognized him as his elder brother. Naturally, he couldn't ignore it when he saw his younger brother being bullied.
"Who are you? How dare you interfere with the affairs of our Martial Arts Alliance? Are you sure you want to go against the Martial Arts Alliance?"
Yue Yun also got up from the ground at this moment, and wiped the blood from his mouth with his hand. Yue Yun was very surprised. You must know that he is a warrior with a small amount of inner strength. His physical body is extremely powerful, and few ordinary warriors can defeat him. But now he was actually beaten away by the young man in front of him and broke one of his ribs. Naturally, he was extremely surprised. He wanted to find out who the other person was.
"This is my boss, Master Chen of Chuzhou, Chen Beixuan. He is a master martial artist. Why don't you kneel down?"
With the support of his boss, Ouyang Feng felt much happier and said loudly.
"Master Chen from Chuzhou?"
"Chen Beixuan?"
…
Hearing Ouyang Feng's words, Yue Yun and others looked at each other, feeling that they sounded familiar, but they just couldn't remember where they had heard them.
"Boy, I don't care who you are, but you have to know that we are members of the Martial Arts Alliance and represent the official. Are you sure you want to go against the official and our Martial Arts Alliance?"
Yue Yun said coldly, he felt that Chen Feng in front of him should be stronger than him, otherwise he wouldn't have hurt him with a slap.Therefore, Yue Yun hopes to use his strong background to convince Chen Feng. After all, Yue Yun's martial arts alliance represents the official power of Jiangbei.
"Guan your sister."
